name: Titan Scroll: Eonar kill hook never procs inside a capital city
contract: AREA_FLAG_CAPITAL gates the hook before the 10% roll (mirrors PlayerUpdates.cpp:1419's own capital check). A kill inside Stormwind must never cast 993963, whatever the RNG roll. The buff does not stack (993957 StackAmount 1), so the fixture carries its single stack.
